<issue_description>
Heap buffer overflow in xmlCopyCharMultiByte (parserInternals.c), triggered during comment parsing via xmlParseCommentComplex/xmlParseComment in parser.c. Under certain crafted inputs the code writes a byte past the end of the allocated comment buffer, causing heap corruption that can lead to crashes or other memory-corruption based exploits when parsing XML comments.
